description: No CDASH/CDISC controlled terminology codelist exists for type of tobacco/smoking product -- this is a sponsor-defined SU-domain supplemental item, not part of core CDASH terminology. Both BioIVT studies already used identical values under different list names (smok_typ in Precision, smok in Detroit); this is a pure deduplication into one shared list, no value changes.
source: No CDASH standard exists; consolidating identical existing values from both BioIVT studies as-is
